expected_level_description: You can: - calculate pay, enhancements, overtime, sickness, and family leave payments - apply tax, pension, and other deductions correctly - check payroll outputs and correct errors before payment - recover overpayments sensitively and in line with policy
You can: - use spreadsheets well, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables - maintain finance system data, such as cost centres, suppliers, and approvers - report and help fix system problems
You can: - follow the organisation's financial procedures and schemes of delegation - recognise signs of possible fraud or error and report them
You can: - recognise sales tax on invoices and code it correctly - explain when to ask a tax specialist for advice

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly
You can: - describe the main parts of the health and care system and the services the organisation supports - explain why patient safety and confidentiality matter in your work
